_note: GenerateImage calls for the vagrant and the merchant, four views each (front S, back N, left W, right E). Paths are absolute under /workspace/lk-art-redo. save_as is the file `hero_sprites.py <name> views` reads. The front view uses the engineer style reference; the other three use that front view. No video.

args.description: Full-body game character reference of the vagrant from the reference image, front view, facing the camera. The reference shows no vagrant: it is a thatched timber house; draw one vagrant and nothing else, no house and no trees; use the reference only for the colours of the cloak and the tunic. Same design exactly: a travel-worn vagrant with a short brown beard, a patched grey-brown hooded cloak the colour of weathered timber, a faded cream tunic, a frayed rope belt, scuffed brown boots, empty hands, no weapon. Match the rendering style of the second reference image exactly: the same chunky voxel pixel-art look, block size, outline-free shading and soft lighting, but not its design. Whole figure from the top of the head to the boots, standing in a neutral idle pose, arms relaxed, feet on the ground, nothing cropped. Plain flat white background, no floor, no shadow, no text, no other figures. One single view only, not a sheet of several views.
